description: Explains John Napier’s scaled logarithms for trigonometric tables, their distinction from modern logarithm conventions, calculating rods and spherical-triangle rules amid sixteenth-century Scottish landholding and religious conflict. Follows the publication of his methods and later collaboration with Henry Briggs.
